Name: CleanUi
Author: lwinnn
Description:
This is a UI mod that brings fresh, clean and easy to read design to the game.

[b]Important[/b]
- [u]All Stardew Valley languages are available.[/u]
- It might not work with other content packs.
- Some parts of ui is still under development. Leave a feedback if you find a bug.

[b]Features[/b]
- new design for main menu (inventory and other tabs)
- new mouse cursor (left click and other type of action)
- new fonts for numbers
- new toolbar
- new top-right bar
- new notification bar
- updated some icons
- updated other windows (title screen, npc window)

[b]Installation[/b]
1. Extract zip archive in Mods folder.
2. It should look like this: "Stardew Vally\Mods\CleanUi"

[b]Requirement[/b]
- See Requirement section.

[b]Changelog[/b]
- See Changelog section.
